### Time with God - September 23
Author: John North
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-september-23-2021.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 29:3
Points:
- David contributed generously from his personal wealth to prepare the temple, even though he would never worship in it himself.
- His devotion was driven by love for God's house and a desire to bless future generations.
- Christians are challenged to reject a consumer mindset that views church attendance only as a way to receive personal blessings.
- Believers should follow David's example by gladly investing their time, energy, and finances to strengthen the body of Christ.

### Day 84: 1 Chronicles 29:1–9
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-84-1-chronicles-29-19.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 29:1-9
Points:
- David recognized that his young son Solomon would need strong support and godly examples to carry out the sacred task of building the temple.
- Rather than compelling the leaders to give by royal command, David motivated them by his own example.
- David demonstrated genuine devotion by giving sacrificially out of his own private treasures over and above state provisions.
- When spiritual leaders show wholehearted surrender and generosity to God, it sparks joyful, willing commitment throughout the entire community.
